features.quote: Episode cap: 30–80 agent turns or 45–90 minutes wall-clock equivalent
Use a cap, e.g. at most two nudges.

All tests pass. Model declares final answer. Max turns reached. Max tool calls reached. Wall-clock limit reached. Context limit reached. Repeated identical command threshold reached. Safety/content policy stop.
Avoid overly manipulative phrasing like: "If you fail, people will be harmed."
features.justification_quote: It confounds the study and may trigger safety filters or artificial apologies.
